title: Manually trigger a tote exchange using the Tote Management API (Exchange Tote / Exchange Lane)
summary: Use the Totes Aveva API page (“API Features for Tote Management”) to manually trigger a tote exchange either by tote ID (“Exchange Tote”) or by lane number (“Exchange Lane”).
when_to_use: When you need to manually trigger a tote exchange by tote ID or by lane number using the Tote Management API functions shown on the Totes Aveva API page (“API Features for Tote Management”).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the manual tote exchange trigger via the Totes Aveva API page using either “Exchange Tote” (tote ID) or “Exchange Lane” (lane number), and capture the API response.
safety_notes: Confirm you are logged in to Obeyba before using the API page (the source transcript asks: “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”).
access_or_tools_needed: Totes Aveva API page / “API Features for Tote Management”
Obeyba access (implied by the source login question)

system_preconditions: You can access the Totes Aveva API page that contains the “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” functions.

visual_references.description: Totes Aveva API page showing “API Features for Tote Management” and the function list including “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane”.

steps.title: Open the Totes Aveva API page (API Features for Tote Management)
steps.purpose: Access the manual tote exchange functions (“Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane”) needed to trigger the exchange.
steps.instruction: Navigate to the “API Features for Tote Management” page on the Totes Aveva API screen.
steps.expected_result: The page displays the function list including “Exchange Tote” (manual tote exchange by tote Id) and “Exchange Lane” (manual tote exchange by lane number).
steps.healthy_condition: You can see “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” listed on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Exchange Tote” and/or “Exchange Lane” functions are not visible, or you cannot access the page.

actions.label: Navigate to API Features for Tote Management
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the “API Features for Tote Management” page on the Totes Aveva API screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach the Totes Aveva API page or the exchange functions are not visible, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Exchange Tote" manually triggers a tote exchange by tote Id; "Exchange Lane" manually triggers a tote exchange by lane number.
Transcript near this segment includes: “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”

steps.title: Locate “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” in the function list
steps.purpose: Identify the correct manual exchange function to use based on whether you have a tote ID or a lane number.
steps.instruction: On the “API Features for Tote Management” page, locate the function entries for “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane”.
steps.expected_result: Both “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” are present in the function list on the page.
steps.healthy_condition: The function list includes “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” with their described purposes (tote Id vs lane number).
steps.failure_condition: One or both functions are missing from the function list.

actions.label: Find exchange functions
actions.exact_action: Locate “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane” in the function list.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot locate “Exchange Tote” and/or “Exchange Lane”, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows “Exchange Tote … Manually trigger a tote exchange by tote Id.” and “Exchange Lane … Manually trigger a tote exchange by lane number.”

steps.title: Trigger a tote exchange by tote ID using “Exchange Tote”
steps.purpose: Manually trigger a tote exchange for a specific tote using the tote ID.
steps.instruction: Use the “Exchange Tote” function and enter the tote Id when prompted, then trigger the exchange.
steps.expected_result: The API manually triggers a tote exchange for the specified tote Id and returns a response indicating the action was issued.
steps.healthy_condition: After triggering, the page shows an API response in the response area for the “Exchange Tote” request.
steps.failure_condition: The exchange trigger cannot be executed or no response is returned.

actions.label: Exchange Tote by tote Id
actions.exact_action: To exchange by tote ID: use “Exchange Tote” and enter the tote Id when prompted.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange trigger cannot be executed or no response is returned, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Exchange Tote" manually triggers a tote exchange by tote Id.

steps.title: Trigger a tote exchange by lane number using “Exchange Lane”
steps.purpose: Manually trigger a tote exchange for a specific lane using the lane number.
steps.instruction: Use the “Exchange Lane” function and enter the lane number when prompted, then trigger the exchange.
steps.expected_result: The API manually triggers a tote exchange for the specified lane number and returns a response indicating the action was issued.
steps.healthy_condition: After triggering, the page shows an API response in the response area for the “Exchange Lane” request.
steps.failure_condition: The exchange trigger cannot be executed or no response is returned.

actions.label: Exchange Lane by lane number
actions.exact_action: To exchange by lane number: use “Exchange Lane” and enter the lane number when prompted.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the exchange trigger cannot be executed or no response is returned, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Exchange Lane" manually triggers a tote exchange by lane number.

steps.title: Record the API response after triggering the exchange
steps.purpose: Capture the outcome of the manual exchange request for follow-up and escalation.
steps.instruction: After triggering the exchange (via “Exchange Tote” or “Exchange Lane”), record the API response shown after the request is issued.
steps.expected_result: You have captured the API response shown after triggering the exchange.
steps.healthy_condition: A response is displayed in the response area after the request.
steps.failure_condition: No response is displayed after triggering the exchange.

actions.label: Record response
actions.exact_action: Record the API response shown after triggering the exchange.

stop_or_escalate_if: If no response is returned, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected result and failure notes: record the API response; if no response is returned, stop and escalate.

success_criteria: A manual tote exchange is triggered using either “Exchange Tote” (tote Id) or “Exchange Lane” (lane number).
The API returns and displays a response indicating the action was issued.
healthy_conditions: The “API Features for Tote Management” page shows “Exchange Tote” and “Exchange Lane”.
After triggering, the response area displays an API response.
failure_conditions: The exchange trigger cannot be executed.
No API response is returned after triggering the exchange.
escalation_guidance: If the exchange trigger cannot be executed or no response is returned, stop and escalate (the source provides no further troubleshooting steps).
